text.p: (in thousands, except per share amounts and ratios)
Pro Forma Earnings Per Share (D) 0.23 N/A

Notes:(A) Results are as of December 31, 1996 and 1995, and have been restated to represent Homestead Village as a single entity. On October 17, 1996, Homestead Village acquired all extended-stay lodging assets operating or to be operated under the Homestead Village trademark through merger of various subsidiaries of Security Capital Group Inc, Security Capital Pacific Trust and Security Capital Atlantic Inc, all affiliates of Homestead Village, in exchange for common stock.
(B) Comparable properties defined as those that were fully operational from January 1, 1995, through December 31, 1996.
(C) Earnings before interest, income taxes, depreciation and amortization.
(D) No historical earnings-per-share data presented due to potential misleading information resulting from numerous assumptions that would be required.
Full company name is Homestead Village Inc.
